parsed.rationale: Both participating records live under paths that are characteristic of sample/example app entry points: `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift` sits inside an `Examples/` directory tree, and `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift` is a standalone preview/harness app for the `PlayerHeaderView` package. The `body` computed property on a SwiftUI `App` conformance is boilerplate mandated by the framework (a single `WindowGroup` or `ContentView` call), so structural identity here is coincidental and expected. Merging these entry points would conflate two independent runnable targets that exist precisely to be separate. No refactor is warranted.
